name: V2-60 fusion test, pre-declared candidate set

spec_frozen_region.normalization: LF line endings, trailing whitespace stripped per line

verdict.population: inner nested OOF, pooled, with E, 16,142 rows
verdict.arithmetic: round each cost to 4 decimals, compare as integer ten-thousandths
verdict.win: control - cand > band(package05), strict; AND cand - control <= band for every reading; AND f4 guard holds
verdict.lose: cand - control > band on any reading
verdict.c2_win_label: provisional (second-order stacking leakage favours fitted candidates)

clarifications.K1: No Platt in C2 (Nathan, 2026-10-12: "No platt for now it'll overfit and not generalize"). All metrics on the post-E weighted rank. Ruling made after the early inner look (C2 0.376 without, 0.514 with per-fold Platt).
clarifications.K2: Inner-inner references exclude both the outer fold f and the inner fold g.
clarifications.K3: alpha chosen on pooled package05 over the four g blocks, on the pre-E base; ties within 1e-12 go to the larger alpha; alpha_at_grid_max flagged.
clarifications.K4: w = alpha*w_C0 + (1-alpha)*w_fit/sum(w_fit); sum(w_fit)==0 raises; intercept dropped.
clarifications.K5: Off-inner C2: refit on all 16,142 inner rows with all-inner references; alpha by 5-fold LOFO on inner, same procedure; no Platt.
clarifications.K6: effective_params = 1 + (1-alpha)*(nnz(w_fit)-1); also report |w|_1, intercept, optimizer success and nit, in-sample vs nested OOF cost per fold.
clarifications.K7: Bootstrap paired, class-stratified, B=2000, seed 0; LJ one fixed stratum present once (conditional CIs) + LibriSpeech speakers resampled; spoof generators resampled; sensitivity row with LJ resampled as one cluster; holdout, inner f3 and f4 marked degenerate.
clarifications.K8: Holdout ledger: per-key O_EXCL reservation files under outputs/v2/benchmark/holdout_ledger/ are the authority; key excludes benchmark version; two-hash reference allowlist; fusion reads only rules in this file.
clarifications.K9: pandas default float parser for score CSVs.
clarifications.K10: Missing option-B columns -> 'not scored', never a partial blend.
clarifications.K12: Dominance flag: Spearman(column, fused | inner reals) >= 0.95 with weight share < 0.5. Gap = population cost - nested inner cost per reading. Test cut = primary-reading threshold chosen on inner.
clarifications.K13: Log row: validation_score = package05 pooled nested inner; clean_only = same; csv_path = outputs/v2/fusion/v2_60_readout.json; benchmark_version = registry version; notes = brief, package03, EER, basis 16,142, verdict.

followon.larger_model: only if C2 verdict is WIN (provisional); its own pre-declared run

early_look_disclosure: A risk-exploration agent computed preview inner readouts after the candidate table was committed (8c66021): C1 0.452, C3 0.358 (f4 0.224 > guard 0.215), C2 prototype 0.376 package05. No holdout labels touched.
